description_en: Modifies the default global configurations for Data Integration synchronization solution tasks in the current workspace
description_zh: 修改当前工作空间中数据集成同步解决方案任务默认的全局配置
name: UpdateDIProjectConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The destination data source of the Data Integration synchronization solution task. This parameter cannot be empty.
When you invoke the UpdateDIProjectConfig operation to modify the global configurations of the synchronization solutions, only the following destination data sources are supported: analyticdb_for_mysql, odps, elasticsearch, holo, mysql, and polardb
parameters.help_zh:
数据集成同步解决方案任务的目的端数据源。该参数不能为空。
调用UpdateDIProjectConfig修改同步解决方案的全局配置，目前仅支持配置目的端数据源为analyticdb_for_mysql、odps、elasticsearch、holo、mysql及polardb
parameters.name: destination_type

parameters.help_en:
The source data source of the Data Integration synchronization solution task.
When you invoke the UpdateDIProjectConfig operation to modify the global configurations of the synchronization solution task, only the following source data sources are supported: oracle, mysql, polardb, datahub, drds, and analyticdb_for_mysql.
If you do not specify a source data source, the default global configurations take effect for all source data sources
parameters.help_zh:
数据集成同步解决方案任务的源端数据源。
调用UpdateDIProjectConfig修改同步解决方案任务的全局配置，目前仅支持配置源端数据源为oracle、mysql、polardb、datahub、drds及analyticdb_for_mysql。
如果不配置源端数据源，则默认全局配置对所有的源端数据源均生效
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The modified default global configurations for the Data Integration synchronization solution task, which specify the default processing policy for different DDL message types. Use the JSON format. Example:
{"RENAMECOLUMN":"WARNING","DROPTABLE":"WARNING","CREATETABLE":"WARNING","MODIFYCOLUMN":"WARNING","TRUNCATETABLE":"WARNING","DROPCOLUMN":"WARNING","ADDCOLUMN":"WARNING","RENAMETABLE":"WARNING"}

DDL message types:
RENAMECOLUMN: Renames a column.
DROPTABLE: Deletes a table.
CREATETABLE: Creates a table.
MODIFYCOLUMN: Modifies a column type.
TRUNCATETABLE: Truncates a table.
DROPCOLUMN: Deletes a column.
ADDCOLUMN: Adds a column.
RENAMETABLE: Renames a table.

When DataWorks receives a DDL message of a specific type, the processing policy is as follows:
WARNING: Discards the message directly and records alerting information in the real-time synchronization log, indicating that the message was discarded because it failed to execute.
IGNORE: Discards the message directly and does not send it to the destination data source.
CRITICAL: Sets the real-time synchronization task to the error state and stops the node.
NORMAL: Forwards the message to the destination data source for processing. Because different destination data sources may have a different DDL message processing policy, DataWorks only forwards the message
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的数据集成同步解决方案任务默认的全局配置内容（即对不同DDL消息类型配置的默认处理策略）。请使用JSON格式。示例如下：
{"RENAMECOLUMN":"WARNING","DROPTABLE":"WARNING","CREATETABLE":"WARNING","MODIFYCOLUMN":"WARNING","TRUNCATETABLE":"WARNING","DROPCOLUMN":"WARNING","ADDCOLUMN":"WARNING","RENAMETABLE":"WARNING"}

DDL消息类型如下：
RENAMECOLUMN：重命名列。
DROPTABLE：删除表。
CREATETABLE：新建表。
MODIFYCOLUMN：修改列类型。
TRUNCATETABLE：清空表。
DROPCOLUMN：删除列。
ADDCOLUMN：新增列。
RENAMETABLE：重命名表。

DataWorks收到对应类型的DDL消息时，处理策略如下：
WARNING：直接丢弃该消息，同时会在实时同步日志中记录告警信息，指明该消息因执行出错被丢弃。
IGNORE：直接丢弃该消息，不再向目的端数据源发送。
CRITICAL：实时同步任务直接显示出错状态并终止运行。
NORMAL：将相应消息继续下发给目的端数据源，由目的端数据源来处理。因为不同目的端数据源对DDL消息处理策略可能会不同，因此DataWorks只执行转发操作
parameters.name: project_config

Data.description_en: The return result of modifying the default global configurations for Data Integration synchronization solution tasks in the target workspace
Data.description_zh: 修改目标工作空间中数据集成同步解决方案任务默认全局配置的返回结果

Status.description_en:
The status is whether the default global configurations of the Data Integration synchronization solution task are modified successfully. Valid values:
success: The configurations are modified successfully.
fail: The configurations failed to be modified
Status.description_zh:
修改数据集成同步解决方案任务默认的全局配置是否成功。取值如下：
success：修改成功。
fail：修改失败

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues when an error occurs
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的唯一ID。用于出现错误后定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：
true：成功。
false：失败
